Check two ways
### IRS account
Check your refund and opt in for refund status email notifications.
[Sign in](https://sa.www4.irs.gov/ola/refund_status)

Enter your SSN, filing status and refund amount on your return. No sign in.
[Use refund tracker](https://sa.www4.irs.gov/wmr/)
[Refund help](https://www.irs.gov/refunds#help "Refund help")

Answer a few questions to find your options to resolve a tax debt.
[Try the tax debt help tool](https://www.irs.gov/payments/get-help-with-tax-debt)

  * Individuals
  * Businesses
  * Tax professionals

Individuals
###  Your account
[Sign in or create an account](https://sa.www4.irs.gov/ola/) to access and manage your personal tax information in one place.
[How to create an account](https://www.irs.gov/help/creating-an-account-for-irsgov "Creating an account for IRS.gov")
[What you can do with an account](https://www.irs.gov/payments/online-account-for-individuals "Online account for individuals")
###  Amended return
[File an amended return](https://www.irs.gov/filing/file-an-amended-return "File an amended return") to fix a mistake on your tax return.
[Check the status of your amended return](https://www.irs.gov/filing/wheres-my-amended-return "Where’s My Amended Return?")
###  Identity protection PIN (IP PIN)
To get an IP PIN, [sign in or create an account](https://sa.www4.irs.gov/icce-core/loac/ippin/pages/ippin.xhtml).
You can also [get one with an application or in person](https://www.irs.gov/identity-theft-fraud-scams/get-an-identity-protection-pin#alternatives "Get an identity protection PIN").
[Retrieve or reissue an IP PIN](https://www.irs.gov/identity-theft-fraud-scams/retrieve-your-ip-pin "Retrieve your IP PIN")
[An IP PIN](https://www.irs.gov/identity-theft-fraud-scams/get-an-identity-protection-pin "Get an identity protection PIN") is a six-digit number that prevents someone else from filing a tax return with your Social Security number (SSN) or individual taxpayer identification number (ITIN). The IP PIN is known only to you and the IRS. It helps us verify your identity when you file an electronic or paper return.
###  Transcripts and tax records
To view your tax records and transcripts, [sign in or create an account](https://sa.www4.irs.gov/ola/tax_records/transcripts).
You can also [request a transcript by mail](https://sa.www4.irs.gov/oat/).
[About transcripts](https://www.irs.gov/individuals/transcript-types-for-individuals-and-ways-to-order-them "Transcript types for individuals and ways to order them")
###  Tax scam, fraud or identity theft
[Report to us](https://www.irs.gov/help/report-fraud "Report fraud") if you suspect a tax scam, fraud or identity theft.
[How to know it’s the IRS](https://www.irs.gov/help/how-to-know-its-the-irs "How to know it's the IRS")
###  Resources for individuals 
[Go to individual tax filing](https://www.irs.gov/individual-tax-filing "Individual tax filing")
###  Contact
Contact us by phone or in person.
### Phone
We’re available 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time.
  * United States: [800-829-1040](tel:800-829-1040)
  * TTY/TDD: [800-829-4059](tel:800-829-4059)
  * International: [Call or live chat](https://www.irs.gov/help/contact-my-local-office-internationally "Contact my local office internationally")


**Before you call**
Have this information ready:
  * Social Security number (SSN) or individual taxpayer identification number (ITIN)
  * Filing status – single, head of household, married filing jointly, married filing separately or qualifying surviving spouse
  * Tax return you’re calling about
  * Prior-year tax return
  * Any correspondence we sent you


### In person
Make an appointment for help at a local [IRS Taxpayer Assistance Center (TAC)](https://www.irs.gov/help/contact-your-local-irs-office "Contact your local IRS office"). 
Businesses
###  Your account
[Sign in or create an account](https://sa.www4.irs.gov/bola/) to manage your business tax information.
[How to create an account](https://www.irs.gov/help/creating-an-account-for-irsgov "Creating an account for IRS.gov")
[What you can do with an account](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/business-tax-account "Business Tax Account")
###  Employer Identification Number (EIN)
[Get an EIN](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/get-an-employer-identification-number "Get an employer identification number") for free from the IRS. This federal tax identification number is for businesses, tax-exempt organizations and other entities.
[Find out if you need an EIN](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/employer-identification-number "Employer identification number")
###  Employment tax
[Deposit and report federal employment taxes](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/depositing-and-reporting-employment-taxes "Depositing and reporting employment taxes")
Employers are required to pay employment taxes. These include federal income tax and Additional Medicare tax withheld, and both the employer and employee Social Security and Medicare taxes.
###  Estimated tax
[Pay estimated tax](https://www.irs.gov/payments "Payments ")
[Estimated taxes](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/estimated-taxes "Estimated taxes") are paid quarterly based on the income you expect your business to receive in a year. Federal income tax in the US is paid as you earn income.
###  Standard mileage rates
View a table of [standard mileage rates](https://www.irs.gov/tax-professionals/standard-mileage-rates "Standard mileage rates") for 2025. 
###  Transcripts and records
[Request a transcript for your business](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/get-a-business-tax-transcript "Get a business tax transcript"). You can choose from different transcript types.
###  Resources for businesses
[Go to the business tax center](https://www.irs.gov/businesses "Businesses")
###  Contact
[Find phone numbers for business customer service](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/telephone-assistance-contacts-for-business-customers "Telephone assistance contacts for business customers")
Tax professionals
###  Tax Pro Account
[Sign in or create an account](https://sa.www4.irs.gov/taxpro/) to request individual POA and TIA, withdraw active authorizations, view client tax information and make payments on behalf of individuals.
[How to create an account](https://www.irs.gov/help/creating-an-account-for-irsgov "Creating an account for IRS.gov")
[What you can do with an account](https://www.irs.gov/tax-professionals/tax-pro-account "Tax Pro Account")
###  e-Services
[Use e-Services](https://www.irs.gov/e-services "E-Services") to access:
  * E-file provider services
  * Affordable Care Act (ACA)
  * Information Returns Intake System (IRIS)
  * Transcript Delivery System (TDS)
  * Taxpayer identification number (TIN) matching
  * Application Program Interface (API) Client ID


###  PTIN requirements
[Apply for or renew a PTIN](https://rpr.irs.gov/ptin)
Anyone who prepares or assists in preparing federal tax returns for compensation must have a valid [preparer tax identification number (PTIN)](https://www.irs.gov/tax-professionals/ptin-requirements-for-tax-return-preparers "PTIN requirements for tax return preparers"). 
###  TIN matching
[Sign in to TIN matching](https://la.www4.irs.gov/esrv/tinm/) to validate a taxpayer identification number (TIN) and name combination.

Tax-exempt organizations
###  Your account
[Sign in or create an account](https://sa.www4.irs.gov/bola/) to manage tax information for your tax-exempt organization.
[How to create an account](https://www.irs.gov/help/creating-an-account-for-irsgov "Creating an account for IRS.gov")
[What you can do with an account](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/business-tax-account "Business Tax Account")
###  Annual filing and forms
[Find Forms 990 and filing requirements](https://www.irs.gov/charities-non-profits/annual-filing-and-forms "Annual filing and forms")
###  Apply for tax-exempt status
[Apply for tax-exempt status](https://www.irs.gov/charities-non-profits/applying-for-tax-exempt-status "Applying for tax exempt status") as a 501(c)(3), 501(c)(4), or 501(a). 
###  Charitable contributions
Confirm an organization is eligible to receive tax-deductible charitable contributions. [Search tax exempt organizations](https://www.irs.gov/charities-non-profits/search-for-tax-exempt-organizations "Search for tax exempt organizations") to check tax-exempt status and filings.
[Find charitable contribution information](https://www.irs.gov/charities-non-profits/charitable-contributions "Charitable contributions")
###  Employer identification number (EIN) 
[Get an EIN](https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/get-an-employer-identification-number "Get an employer identification number") for free from the IRS. This federal tax identification number is required to apply for tax-exempt status and file returns.
You must be a legally formed organization before you apply for an EIN.
###  Resources for charities and nonprofits 
[Go to the charities and nonprofits tax center](https://www.irs.gov/charities-and-nonprofits "Charities and nonprofits")
###  Contact 
[Contact Exempt Organizations customer service](https://www.irs.gov/charities-non-profits/contact-irs-exempt-organizations "Contact IRS exempt organizations")
